newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Yapi Kredi Bank plans GDRs in U.S., Europe.
newsitem.headline: Turk Yapi Kredi Bank plans GDRs in U.S., Europe.

text.p: Yapi ve Kredi Bankasi A.S., one of Turkey's leading private commercial banks, plans to issue Global Depository Receipts (GDR) on the U.S. and European markets from June 9, the bank said in a statement.

Part of the bank shares kept in portfolios of the major shareholder Cukurova group would be offered for sale to foreigners in the form of GDRs, the bank said in a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
It did not give the amounts of shares to be sold from the portfolios of the group firms Cukurova Holding, Sinai ve Mali Yatirimlar Holding, Endustri Holding and Cukurova Ithalat.
